sys_di_key.description:
Analyze the document and locate the following values from the latest available financial year:
1. "Trade Payables" from the section titled "5(B) BALANCE SHEET" 2. "Cost of Materials Consumed" from the section titled "5(C) PROFIT & LOSS"
Calculate A/P Days using the formula:
A/P Days = (Trade Payables / Cost of Materials Consumed) × 365
Rules: 1. Use values only from the latest financial year column. 2. Return only the calculated A/P Days value. 3. Round the result to 2 decimal places. 4. Do not extract or calculate using: - Trade Receivables - Inventory Days - Current Ratio - Working Capital Turnover - Purchases of Stock in Trade 5. If "Cost of Materials Consumed" is 0, "-", blank, or missing, return "NA". 6. Output must contain only the calculated numeric value.
Example Output: 216.97
sys_di_key.name: A/P Days
